integrity: Full analytical proof and a standalone finite verification program are embedded. Finite tests do not substitute for the proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two known nonempty fixed eligibility supports, identical unit-size indivisible items, finite agent sets. No claim for three or more eligibility types, unequal item sizes, unknown type alphabets, envy or strategic guarantees. An unindexed equivalent construction remains a novelty risk.
title: Exact prefixwise global quota for two online eligibility types
